texto:
In my city, a new project started last year: a community garden. This is a special place where people who live in apartments can grow their own food. The city gave us a small piece of empty land next to the library. At first, it was just dirt and stones, but now it is full of life. We have tomatoes, carrots, lettuce, and beautiful flowers. Everyone works together on weekends. We plant seeds, water the plants, and keep the garden clean.

The best part is the fresh food. It tastes much better than the food from the supermarket. It is also very healthy. But the garden is more than just food. It’s a place to meet neighbors and make friends. Children learn where food comes from, and older people can share their gardening knowledge. It's a quiet and relaxing space in a busy city. This project has brought our community closer.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, where is the community garden located?

opciones.C: On the roof of an apartment building

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es la D. El texto proporciona la ubicación exacta del jardín en la frase: 'The city gave us a small piece of empty land next to the library'. This directly answers the question. Las otras opciones son incorrectas porque, aunque son lugares posibles para un jardín comunitario, no son los que se mencionan en el texto. The text mentions 'the supermarket' only to compare the taste of the food, not as a location for the garden.

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, what can we infer about the community before the garden project?

opciones.A: They did not like eating fresh vegetables.
opciones.B: They already had big gardens at their homes.
opciones.C: They thought gardening was too difficult.
opciones.D: They were too busy to start a new project.
opciones.E: They probably did not interact with each other much.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es la E. El texto no dice esto directamente, pero podemos inferirlo. El texto dice que el jardín 'is a place to meet neighbors and make friends' y que el proyecto 'has brought our community closer'. This implies that before the garden, the neighbors were not very close and didn't interact much. Las otras opciones son incorrectas: B es lo contrario de lo que dice el texto ('people who live in apartments'), y no hay información en el texto para apoyar A, C o D.
